cues.text: Inside a tent
cues.why_ranked: major scene jump from body in snowfield to tent interior

cues.text: A red-haired girl watches.
cues.why_ranked: establishes who she is with the robed man

cues.text: A hand reaches
cues.why_ranked: she reaches toward the old man's hands

cues.text: Something off screen.
cues.why_ranked: she is simply alone in same scene

cues.text: She runs alone down a narrow alley strewn with fallen bricks and collapsed timber.
cues.why_ranked: moves story to ruined alley, she is running

cues.text: A blade strapped to her back, she clambers over the bricks, heading deeper into the alley.
cues.why_ranked: camera move only, no new information

cues.text: She's young, hair cropped short, pale tank top, fingerless gloves.
cues.why_ranked: closer framing revealing costume detail

cues.text: She uncovers a knobbled dark fruit, holding it in both hands, glancing aside.
cues.why_ranked: she holds a fruit, minor beat

cues.text: She's up on the rooftops now, leaping from a ledge between buildings.
cues.why_ranked: she is now up on the rooftops

cues.text: She lands, frowning. A metal guard straps her tattooed shoulder.
cues.why_ranked: cut to her face, only shows tattoo

cues.text: She stares down at the collapsed creature, lips parting, alarm crossing her face.
cues.why_ranked: her reaction motivates looking down at what follows

cues.text: The small winged dragon lies bleeding on the stones. Her hand reaches toward it.
cues.why_ranked: reveals the wounded dragon, the film's central discovery

cues.text: The dragon stays put. The outstretched hand waits, unanswered.
cues.why_ranked: her hand reaching, dragon holds still

cues.text: Indoors now, she holds the creature down. Something sounds off screen.
cues.why_ranked: location shift indoors with her holding the bleeding creature

cues.text: She cradles the creature, smiling at it.
cues.why_ranked: creature now healed and small, time has passed

cues.text: Her gloved hand sweeps crumbs across a mat toward a stone bowl.
cues.why_ranked: close detail of crumbs and bowl

cues.text: A dim room: someone in dark clothes stands over a low bed with pink covers.
cues.why_ranked: shift to dim interior with a figure by a bed

cues.text: She sleeps curled on the bed, blanket drawn over her.
cues.why_ranked: reveals a woman asleep, new situation

cues.text: Elsewhere, hands feed the creature from a leather pouch.
cues.why_ranked: creature has grown large, she feeds it

cues.text: Outside now, she hurries along a crate-lined street, passing a tall armed figure.
cues.why_ranked: story moves to a sunlit street

cues.text: A bald man and a blonde woman watch her weave off through the crowded market stalls.
cues.why_ranked: introduces two people watching her

cues.text: She turns sharply, eyes wide, toward something out of sight.
cues.why_ranked: her surprise signals something offscreen

cues.text: Outside under sailcloth awnings, she grins upward. Something small drops through the air.
cues.why_ranked: outdoors, something falls toward her

cues.text: She's back down in a sunlit cobbled street, baskets and barrels behind her, smiling faintly.
cues.why_ranked: another street shot, little new
